title: Coding agent exposed a credential for Together AI customer prompt samples
summary: Together AI says a coding agent exposed a credential in its public xorl GitHub repository, allowing an unauthorised party to download stored customer prompt samples. The company was still reviewing which customers and sensitive data were affected.
contextEvidence: Together AI describes the agent working on its own software development. The coding agent and model provider are not identified.

sources.label: Together AI — Security Event: Prompt Leakage for Requests in June and July of 2026
sources.evidenceNote: CEO Vipul Ved Prakash's account gives no commit or download dates. June/July and the named inference models describe sampled requests, not the incident timing or coding agent.

events.title: Credential committed to public repository
events.summary: Together AI says a coding agent committed a credential for a private Hugging Face repository containing customer prompt samples authorised for routine software testing. Automated scanning detected the credential and the commit was reverted.

events.title: Unauthorised party downloaded stored prompt samples
events.summary: Together AI says an unauthorised party obtained the credential while it was exposed and downloaded the samples, then tested credentials found in them. Five of those credentials were canaries from a Dragos experiment.
